# xshield_policy_changes (Data Source)

What a deployment would change, and on how many assets.

Read this before running `xshield_policy_deployment` to see the size of the change. `pending` lists ports whose review decision the assets are not yet enforcing; `under_test` lists ports already deployed in test mode, which is the set a move to enforce would affect.

The violation and days-in-test figures are how to judge whether a port is ready to enforce: a port under test for weeks with no violations is safe to enforce, one with violations is not.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `criteria` (String) Criteria selecting the assets, written against the asset scope.

### Optional

- `direction` (String) Which direction of policy to report on. Defaults to inbound.
- `filter` (String) `pending` reports ports whose review state differs from what is enforced. `under_test` reports ports already deployed in test mode. Defaults to `pending`.
- `min_days_in_test` (Number) With `under_test`, report only ports that have been under test at least this long. Ignored for `pending`.
- `violation_threshold` (Number) With `under_test`, report only ports at or above this violation count. Ignored for `pending`.

### Read-Only

- `pending_count` (Number) How many reported ports need a deployment to take effect.
- `reviewed_ports` (Attributes List) Ports carrying a review decision. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--reviewed_ports))
- `unreviewed_ports` (Attributes List) Ports with no review decision. A deployment leaves these logging rather than blocking, whatever mode it runs in. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--unreviewed_ports))

<a id="nestedatt--reviewed_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `reviewed_ports`

Read-Only:

- `affected_assets_count` (Number) How many of the matched assets this port change would touch.
- `average_days_in_test` (Number) How long the port has been deployed in test mode, averaged over the affected assets.
- `is_deployment_required` (Boolean) True when the port's decision is not yet what the assets enforce.
- `listen_port` (String) Port number, or a range.
- `listen_port_name` (String)
- `listen_port_protocol` (String)
- `port_category` (String)
- `violation_count` (Number) Traffic that would have been blocked had this port been enforced. Above zero means enforcing it would break something.


<a id="nestedatt--unreviewed_ports"></a>
### Nested Schema for `unreviewed_ports`

Read-Only:

- `affected_assets_count` (Number) How many of the matched assets this port change would touch.
- `average_days_in_test` (Number) How long the port has been deployed in test mode, averaged over the affected assets.
- `is_deployment_required` (Boolean) True when the port's decision is not yet what the assets enforce.
- `listen_port` (String) Port number, or a range.
- `listen_port_name` (String)
- `listen_port_protocol` (String)
- `port_category` (String)
- `violation_count` (Number) Traffic that would have been blocked had this port been enforced. Above zero means enforcing it would break something.
